title: Implementation step result
description: The machine-readable tail of an /implement-phase or /tdd-phase run. Consumed by drive-step.sh and drive-scope-check.mjs.

status.description: committed — the phase landed as one commit. blocked — the phase cannot proceed (plan/reality mismatch, red gate that is not this phase's to fix). needs_input — a human decision or an action the step is not permitted to take.

commit_sha.description: Short SHA of the phase commit; null for any status other than committed.

touched_files.description: Every repo-relative path this step created, edited, or deleted — the same set that was staged. Not derived from git status.

out_of_scope.description: Files touched that the phase's declared `paths:` did not cover, each with the reason it was necessary. Declared is allowed; undeclared is what triage flags as WARNING "unplanned".

diff_lines.description: Total changed lines in the phase commit (added + deleted), from git diff --shortstat. Compared against the row's declared size: >2x forces a drift review.

gate_recorded.description: True when this step ran the phase's automated Done-when criteria and recorded the result, so the reviewer reads the line instead of re-running a green gate.

notes.description: One short paragraph for the orchestrator: what deviated from the row, what was deferred and why, or what blocked. Never a restatement of the phase title.
